{{Quote|I'm not a slaver. I'm here to free these people.|[[Bria Tharen]]|<ref name="RD" />}}
The '''capture of the ''Helot's Shackle''''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] mission to liberate [[Slavery|slaves]] being transported from the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Emancipator (CR90 corvette)|''Helot's Shackle'']]. Assembling outside the [[Cha Raaba system|Ylesia system]], [[Red Hand Squadron]], under the command of [[Bria Tharen]] and comprising the [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]] [[Retribution (Marauder-class)|''Retribution'']] and the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]] of [[Crimson Fury]], [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumped]] into the [[Star system/Legends|system]] after a rebel operative signaled that the ''Helot's Shackle'' had departed Ylesia and launched their attack. When the target [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was disabled, the Rebels boarded it and took control, [[Death/Legends|killing]] many of the [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] crew in the process. Tharen had the wounded slavers executed before taking the captured vessel to rendezvous with the rebel ship [[Deliverance (Rebel Alliance)|''Deliverance'']] to transfer the freed slaves, many of whom subsequently volunteered to join the Alliance. The ''Helot's Shackle'' itself was refitted to serve as a rebel combat ship and Tharen renamed the ship ''Emancipator''.<ref name="RD" />
